episodes.title: Part One: The Boyfriend
episodes.summary: In 2015, California couple Aaron Quinn and Denise Huskins were attacked at home during the night. After Denise was kidnapped, Aaron became a suspect.

episodes.title: Part Two: Gone Girl
episodes.summary: Days later, Denise reappears seemingly unharmed and recalls the details of her terrifying abduction as doubts from authorities begin to swirl.

episodes.title: Part Three: The Others
episodes.summary: More attempted kidnappings lead detectives to a new — and unexpected — suspect. Aaron and Denise go head-to-head with the Vallejo Police Department.
